predictions.selection: Panathinaikos to win (money line; -15.5 point spread the handicap angle)
predictions.headline: Francisco and Lessort power table-topping Panathinaikos against bottom-ranked Baskonia in Athens
predictions.body: Panathinaikos on the money line—with our -15.5 model spread as the handicap angle—is the standout European basketball play when Round 7 visits Telekom Center Athens on Thursday night. Under returning head coach Zeljko Obradovic, the Greens lead the 20-club EuroLeague at 5-1 with a competition-best +90 differential (528 scored, 438 conceded), paced by guard Sylvain Francisco (15.8 points and 4.5 assists per game) and center Mathias Lessort (19.5 PIR and 6.5 rebounds). After dismantling Partizan 72-55 away in Round 5 before an 81-91 loss to Hapoel Tel Aviv, Panathinaikos meet a 20th-placed Kosner Baskonia side sitting dead last at 1-5 (-60 differential) following Friday's 86-78 loss at Virtus Bologna under new boss Velimir Perasovic.

predictions.headline: Zebre's 17 tries conceded in three rounds sets up a Galway home win for Connacht
predictions.body: Backing Connacht to win in three-way match betting—or stepping into the handicap given the short outright price—is the call under Friday night lights at Dexcom Stadium. Sitting 14th in the United Rugby Championship on 5 points after three rounds, Connacht crossed three times through a Josh Ioane brace and Sean Jansen in a 36-19 loss at unbeaten Glasgow on 9 October. They now host the one club below them: winless 16th-placed Zebre Parma (1 point, 116 points and 17 tries conceded across three games), who fell 29-12 at home to Edinburgh in Round 3 despite tries from Alessandro Fusco and Giacomo Ferrari.

predictions.selection: Vodacom Bulls to win (3-way match betting)
predictions.headline: Cameron Hanekom and a 42-point Loftus attack make the Bulls clear favourites against winless Ulster
predictions.body: Vodacom Bulls to win in 80-minute match betting is the pick as Pretoria hosts Saturday's early URC Round 4 clash at Loftus Versfeld. Averaging 42 points per game with a league-high 126 scored and +72 differential across three rounds, the Bulls ran in nine tries to crush the Lions 57-15 on 10 October behind two first-half scores from Player of the Match Cameron Hanekom alongside wing Canan Moodie and fly-half Handre Pollard. Eleventh-placed Ulster arrive winless at 0-2-1 (88 scored, 93 conceded) after drawing 26-26 with Munster in Round 3, facing a Pretoria pack that has yielded just seven tries all season.

predictions.headline: Hugo Keenan's sharpness in Leinster's 29-5 rout of Cardiff sets the tone against Munster
predictions.body: Leinster outright in three-way match betting is preferred over laying a tight derby spread against interprovincial rivals Munster on Saturday evening. Although an early South African tour left Leinster 10th on 8 points (1-0-2), their Round 3 home return produced a clinical 29-5 five-try victory over Cardiff sparked by Ireland full-back Hugo Keenan's solo chip-and-chase score and try-saving cover tackle. Having conceded just 58 points and eight tries across three rounds—fourth-fewest in the competition—Leinster look sturdier defensively than ninth-placed Munster (9 points, 1-1-1, 72 scored and 74 conceded), who drew 26-26 at Ulster last time out.

predictions.selection: Buffalo Sabres money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Buffalo's home scoring punch meets a Philadelphia side winless on the road at 0-4-1
predictions.body: Back the Buffalo Sabres on the two-way money line (overtime and shootout included) at KeyBank Center on Wednesday night. Buffalo stand 4-3-2 for 10 points with a solid 3-2-0 home mark and 27 goals through nine games, highlighted by a 5-3 victory over Florida—sealed on Noah Ostlund's third-period power-play goal alongside scoring leaders Tage Thompson and Owen Power—and a 5-4 overtime win in Toronto. Philadelphia sit at 2-6-3 with an Eastern-low 17 goals in 11 outings and a 0-4-1 road record; while Matvei Michkov sparked consecutive home wins over Ottawa and Colorado, the Flyers remain winless away from home.

predictions.headline: Luka Matkava and unbeaten Oyonnax bring a 44.7-point scoring machine to Stade Sapiac
predictions.body: Oyonnax to win away at Montauban—with the minus handicap offering strong secondary value—is the Pro D2 opener to back on Thursday night. Perfect through seven rounds on 33 points (7-0-0), Oyonnax lead the division with 313 points scored (44.7 per game, +159 differential) after pulling away to beat Valence-Romans 51-25 in Round 7 behind Georgian fly-half Luka Matkava's try and eight kicks from the tee plus Inaki Ayarza's post-siren bonus score. Eighth-placed Montauban (17 points, 4-0-3) beat Brive in Round 6 but just shipped 54 points in a 54-28 defeat at Dax, taking their defensive tally to 214 conceded.

predictions.headline: Unbeaten Provence Rugby look rock-solid on home turf against 14th-placed Beziers
predictions.body: Provence Rugby to win in 80-minute match betting is the straightforward call under Friday night lights at Stade Maurice-David, while leaving an inflated four-try handicap alone. Joint-unbeaten through seven Pro D2 rounds with seven straight victories for 29 points (+64 differential, 222 scored, 158 conceded), Provence showed their composure again last Friday by winning 34-24 away at Nice with Enzo Labadie sparking their first-half response. Fourteenth-placed AS Beziers Herault sit in trouble on 9 points (2-0-5) with 240 points conceded—third-most in the league—after letting slip a 25-24 home defeat against Aurillac in Round 7.

predictions.headline: Antoine Dupont's try-scoring return anchors Top 14 leaders Toulouse against Perpignan
predictions.body: Stade Toulousain outright in three-way match betting is a banker anchor on Saturday afternoon's Top 14 card.
